candidateAudit.text: LALESA Äthiopien Filterkaffee Nach was schmeckt dieser Kaffee für euch? Unser neuer Kaffee aus Gadeb, Äthiopien wächst auf 3,5 Hektar in 2.150 bis 2.200 Metern Höhe. Die Heirloom Sorte wird einmal im Jahr, von Dezember bis Januar geerntet und anschließend anaerob aufbereitet: Die Kirschen fermentieren fünf Tage lang in geschlossenen Plastikfässern, bevor sie 13 bis 18 Tage auf den Beeten trocknen. Ephtah hat 2023 die Trockenstation in Lalesa erworben. Mit über 400 Trockenbeeten ist sie eine der größten in der Region. Sieben Mitarbeiter:innen arbeiten dort fix, zur Erntezeit sind es rund 130. In Gedeb gibt es außerdem eine Kinderbetreuung für Familien der Farmer:innen, und einige Frauen der Region sind Teil des “Ama Commitment”-Programms. Von der Washing Station geht der Kaffee nach Addis Abeba ins Moplaco-Lager in Gerji und dann weiter per Zug nach Djibouti zum Export. In der Tasse schmecken wir Erdbeere, Pfirsich, Maracuja und Schwarztee. Wir empfehlen ihn als Filterkaffee (Pour-over, Aeropress, French Press, Cold Brew) oder als fruchtigen Espresso. #viennacoffee #specialtycoffee #kaffeeröster #süssmundkaffee #ethiopiancoffee

candidateAudit.text: Thanks for joining the opening of the exhibition ‘03: Soil. Between (De-)Composition and (Re-)Construction in the Climate Crisis’ this week! At AIL researchers and artists show their open, collaborative process, which unfolds in a multiperspective inquiry on soil and drought. This creates a dialogue at the intersection of data collection, scientific exploration and artistic translation, in which soil becomes a ground for research, creativity, evidence and metaphor. — on till 5 Nov 2026 Mon–Fri: 11:00–18:00 The exhibition emerges from the project 03: Soil, which is based on interdisciplinary and site-specific artistic research, and is rooted in a collective field exploration of a subalpine ecological research laboratory in the Stubai Valley (Tyrol, Austria). With contributions by: Franziska Allerberger (Geographer), Michael Bahn (Ecologist), Helena Detsch (Visual Artist), Cornelia Dirnberger (Visual Artist), Christian Prohammer (Musician, Audio Engineer), Nora Schöpfer (Visual Artist), Konstantina Maria Serjannis (Cultural Scientist), Johanna Unterpertinger (Musician) Next guided tours: 15 Oct, 16:00–18:00 Guided Tour and Soil Session with Christian Prohammer 21 Oct, 16:00—18:00 Guided Tour and Soil Session with Christian Prohammer 5 Nov 12:00—13:00 Guided Tour 13:15—15:30 Workshop with Franziska Allerberger Out of Balance: On the Quest for Reconnecting (Register via this link) Photos: Hannah Mayr _hannahmayr_ The project 03: Soil is generously supported by ÖAW. oeaw.at

candidateAudit.title: Artificial intelligence is often framed as a quest to replicate the human brain, promising frictionless cognition and a future of seamless automation. But what if this pervasive na
candidateAudit.text: Artificial intelligence is often framed as a quest to replicate the human brain, promising frictionless cognition and a future of seamless automation. But what if this pervasive narrative obscures a deeper, more ‘errant’ truth? Media theorist and author Clemens Apprich in conversation with philosopher Jan Völker. Moderated by Amanda Holmes, Department of Philosophy, University of Applied Arts Vienna Welcome: Ulrike Kuch, Rector of the University of Applied Arts Vienna A cooperation of the department of Media Theory and the department of Philosophy. ‘Errant Intelligence’ challenges the prevailing biological and individualistic interpretations of machine learning, arguing instead for a radical understanding of machine intelligence. The book embraces the deviations, inconsistencies, and ‘errant behaviour’ as fundamental to the discovery of new knowledge, moving beyond the illusion of mere optimisation. Drawing on media theory, cybernetics, and a unique psychoanalytic lens, it explores the ‘technological unconscious’ of machine learning. It traces the historical roots of AI, from early automatons and the Turing machine to natural language processing and contemporary machine learning systems. Challenging the idea of an autonomous, self-generating AI, the book exposes the hidden labour, assumed logics, and inherent biases that animate its operation. It re-evaluates computational thinking, insisting on its inherently social, collective, and symbolic character, and revealing how language and logical paradoxes are not obstacles but constitutive forces that shape intelligent machines

candidateAudit.title: In this workshop with Helena Detsch we will explore simple ways to create a fascinating natural color palette from soil and plant-based materials like earths, minerals, vegetables,
candidateAudit.text: In this workshop with Helena Detsch we will explore simple ways to create a fascinating natural color palette from soil and plant-based materials like earths, minerals, vegetables, kitchen supplies and algae pigments. Part of the exhibition ‘03: Soil. Between (De-)Composition and (Re-)Construction in the Climate Crisis’ Duration: 15:30–17:30 Please register for this workshop via link in bio (free entry) Together, we'll first experiment with making self-made oil- or watercolors from 100% natural sources and then explore the many possibilities of sustainable painting, discovering how these self-made colors behave on paper and fabric and what a truly organic painting practice can look like. In her oil paintings, installations and animations, Helena Detsch explores (mis-)relationships between humans and more-than-human life. Her series and immersive spatial installations question Western anthropocentric narratives about nature as a resource and create spaces to reflect on coexistence and complex interconnections between human and other agents. To develop a more sustainable art practice, she crafts natural colors from plant and soil pigments. helena.kettu AIL, Otto Wagner-Postsparkasse / Georg-Coch-Platz 2, 1010 Vienna dieangewandte

candidateAudit.text: About the next exhibition at AIL: Soil is a highly diverse and sensitive cosmos that is facing increasing pressure due to the climate crisis, as a result of more frequent and severe extreme events such as drought. Soil holds histories, stories and belowground storage systems, repositories of information and traces of past worlds, current developments and future scenarios. What is happening beneath our feet? At AIL researchers and artists show their open, collaborative process, which unfolds in a multiperspective inquiry on soil and drought. This creates a dialogue at the intersection of data collection, scientific exploration and artistic translation, in which soil becomes a ground for research, creativity, evidence and metaphors. With contributions by: Franziska Allerberger (Geographer), Michael Bahn (Ecologist), Helena Detsch (Visual Artist), Cornelia Dirnberger (Visual Artist), Christian Prohammer (Musician, Audio Engineer), Nora Schöpfer (Visual Artist), Konstantina Maria Serjannis (Cultural Scientist), Johanna Unterpertinger (Musician) ’03: Soil. Between (De-)Composition and (Re-)Construction in the Climate Crisis’ emerges from the project 03: Soil, which is based on interdisciplinary and site-specific artistic research, and is rooted in a collective field exploration of a subalpine ecological research laboratory in the Stubai Valley (Tyrol, Austria). Join the extended exhibition program: 6 Oct Exhibition Opening with Performances by Michael Bahn, Johanna Unterpertinger and Christian Prohammer 8 Oct 15:30–17:30 Workshop with Helena Detsch The Organic Painter – Painting

candidateAudit.text: MONTECRISTO Nicaragua Die neue Ernte von unserem beliebten Bio Espresso ist angekommen. Ulrich Salamun und Sabine Khalil bewirtschaften gemeinsam die Finca in Nicaragua. Ihre Kaffees gehören seit den Anfängen von SÜSSMUND Kaffee zu unserem Sortiment – eine Zusammenarbeit, die über die Jahre gewachsen ist. Auf der Finca wird nach biologischen Standards gearbeitet. Die Arabica Bohnen (roter und gelber Catuai) werden unter Schattenbäumen in einem biodivers gehaltenen System angebaut und anschließend als gewaschener Kaffee aufbereitet. Das Resultat ist ein säurearmer, vollmundiger Kaffee, der sich perfekt als schokoladiger Espresso oder als Basis für Milchgetränke eignet. Geschmacksnoten: Walnuss, Dunkle Schokolade, Marille Dieser Kaffee ist momentan auch in unserer Mühle im Shop - solange der Vorrat reicht. #viennacoffee #specialtycoffee #kaffeeröster #newharvest #nicaraguacoffee

At AIL researchers and artists show their open, collaborative process, which unfolds in a multiperspective inquiry on soil and drought. This creates a dialogue at the intersection of data collection, scientific exploration and artistic translation, in which soil becomes a ground for research, creativity, evidence and metaphors. candidateAudit.title: Coming up next as part of VIENNA DESIGN WEEK 2026 🪢 The exhibition ’Zero and One Chairs’ was created as part of MATCH!, a recurring initiative organised by the department of Appli
candidateAudit.text: Coming up next as part of VIENNA DESIGN WEEK 2026 🪢 The exhibition ’Zero and One Chairs’ was created as part of MATCH!, a recurring initiative organised by the department of Applied Photography and Time-Based Media at the University of Applied Arts Vienna, which explores the synergistic potential of student teams from different degree programs. In collaboration with the department Industrial Design, this year’s focus was on the intersection of photography and the object, with particular attention paid to the relationship with set design, styling, casting and narrative. Seen from the perspective of Applied Photography, the object and thus the chair, is a welcome protagonist. Photography’s multiple applied genres are cited here: documentary, fashion, advertising, architecture and the portrait. When the function in Industrial Design coalesces with the idea of the purpose in Applied Photography, the question of factuality emerges. Be not mistaken: The most literal things are often the most confusing and enigmatic. Between what it is and how it is*, worlds unfold. We put the images to work. VDW Cocktail: 29 Sep, 17:00–18:00 Showcase and drinks followed by a collective walk to the billboards in front of the main entrance of the University Open Saturdays: 26 Sep / 3 Oct, 11:00–18:00 Opening hours: Mon–Fri: 11:00–18:00 AIL, Otto Wagner-Postsparkasse / Georg-Coch-Platz 2, 1010 Vienna The collaborative works are on display at the AIL and on the billboards at the university’s main entrance on Oskar-Kokoschka-Platz. dieangewandte viennadesignweek applied.photography angewandte_id Feat

candidateAudit.title: 🔪 How well do you really know your 80s horror movies? 👻 Rodeho’s Rootin’ Tootin’ Pub Quiz returns to Villa Vida Café — and this time, we’re diving into the gloriously bloody, cam
candidateAudit.text: 🔪 How well do you really know your 80s horror movies? 👻 Rodeho’s Rootin’ Tootin’ Pub Quiz returns to Villa Vida Café — and this time, we’re diving into the gloriously bloody, campy and unforgettable world of 1980s horror. 🩸📼 From slashers and supernatural nightmares to cult classics, monsters and final girls, it’s time to find out whether all those hours spent watching horror movies were actually educational. Hosted by drag artist Rodeho, expect horror trivia, drag, queer community and plenty of questionable knowledge finally getting its moment to shine. 📅 Friday, 23 October 2026 ⏰ 19:30–21:30 📍 Villa Vida Café Linke Wienzeile 102, 1060 Vienna 🎟 Donation-based 📝 Registration required — reserve your spot via the link in our bio. Come with a team or come on your own — both are welcome. You definitely don’t need to know everything about 80s horror to take part. 🏳️‍🌈 Villa Vida is a queer community space. People of all genders and sexualities are welcome; we ask everyone attending to respect the queer community and one another. ♿ Accessibility: Step-free access, accessible toilet and accessible indoor seating are available. Service animals are welcome. Come for the horror trivia. Stay for the drag, community and the chance to prove that your extremely specific knowledge of 80s horror villains has a purpose. 🩸

candidateAudit.title: 💘 Friends? Dates? Flirting? Something in between? Meet queer people in Vienna without swiping. 📅 Sat, 26 September 2026 ⏰ 19:00–21:00 📍 Villa Vida Café, Linke Wienzeile 102, 106
candidateAudit.text: 💘 Friends? Dates? Flirting? Something in between? Meet queer people in Vienna without swiping. 📅 Sat, 26 September 2026 ⏰ 19:00–21:00 📍 Villa Vida Café, Linke Wienzeile 102, 1060 Vienna 🎟️ €20 per person · cash at the door 💛 Soli tickets available 📝 Registration required 🌈 Who is it for? Queer people who want to meet other queer people — whether you’re looking for dating, friendship, flirting, new connections, or simply meeting more of the community. You’ll meet multiple people through a series of short mini-dates. Privately note who you’d like to connect with again — romantically, platonically, or otherwise. If you both choose each other, it’s a match. 💌 Contact information is only shared with mutual matches. 🧍 Coming alone? Absolutely. You don’t need to know anyone beforehand. The structured format is there to make meeting people easier, including if you’re shy, introverted, or not into approaching strangers at a bar. 💛 Can’t comfortably afford €20? Soli tickets are available. Request one in the comments when registering — no explanation or justification needed. 🤝 Consent, boundaries and mutual respect are essential. A conversation or flirtation never creates an obligation to share contact details or meet again. Discriminatory or harassing behaviour is not welcome. ♿ Step-free access · accessible seating & toilet · service animals welcome. Please note that simultaneous conversations can mean significant background noise. 📝 Register via the link in bio/event page. Come as you are and see who you click with. 💘

candidateAudit.title: What might consciousness smell like? Is it possible to sense interdependencies? Would you like to experience your embeddedness in the world? The SΫS SPACE prototype by artists duo
candidateAudit.text: What might consciousness smell like? Is it possible to sense interdependencies? Would you like to experience your embeddedness in the world? The SΫS SPACE prototype by artists duo MUELLER-DIVJAK opens its doors for two afternoons in September, inviting you for a one-of-a-kind experience, an exclusive multisensory trail of resonating with and better understanding of living systems. ⚡⚡⚡Currently all individual time slots are taken, but you can sign up for the waiting list! Find the link in our bio! Exclusive one-hour slot for a fascinating journey into your senses and search for a being that knows and feels everything about connectedness and interdependence. The artist and researcher duo MUELLER-DIVJAK (Dr. Jeanette Müller and Dr. Paul Divjak), who is working at the AIL with international artists and systems scientists on the FWF/PEEK project SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS. Exploring the Potentials of Multisensory Scenographies for Systems Awareness (Project lead: Mag. Alexandra Graupner; University of Applied Arts), is devoted to creating experiential multisensory spaces – the so called SΫS SPACEs – that help enhancing systems awareness through special sensory cues. Such allowing for coping resiliently with the complex interrelations and interactions that shape our world and all our lives. mueller_divjak dieangewandte

candidateAudit.text: The Unsafe+Sounds festival, held annually in Vienna, returns in September with a kaleidoscopic program, offering a multifaceted glimpse into the contemporary music scene and AIL is delighted to once again host one event in the program. unsafeandsounds AIL, Otto Wagner-Postsparkasse / Georg-Coch-Platz 2, 1010 Vienna (Free entry) Overview: 18:30 Panel Discussion, unsafe+sounds in cooperation with the Weibel Institute for Digital Cultures (University of Applied Arts Vienna) weibel.institute Affective Histories Timotheus Vermeulen and Christian Höller in conversation with Sophie Publig History is never simply given. It is made through the scales and materials by which the past becomes legible: from sweeping narratives and historical events to gestures, sounds, images, technical infrastructures, and seemingly minor traces SOPHIE PUBLIG is a Senior Scientist researching digital ecosystems. Based at the Weibel Institute for Digital Cultures at the University of Applied Arts Vienna, she navigates the intricate networks of online territories. TIMOTHEUS VERMEULEN is Professor of Media, Culture and Society at the University of Oslo and joint director of the Media Aesthetics Research Group. He was a visiting scholar in Art History at Harvard in 2023–24 and will serve as joint Principal Investigator on a project on the politics of tone at the Centre for Advanced Study in Oslo in 2027–28. CHRISTIAN HÖLLER is editor and co-publisher of springerin – Hefte für Gegenwartskunst. Since 2024 he is head of the department Cross Disciplinary Strategies at the University of Applied Arts Vienna. cro

candidateAudit.title: BANKO GOTITI - definitiv ein Crowd Favourite - ist zurück! Äthiopien Washed Light Roast Wir haben einen neuen Kaffee in unserem Portfolio: Ein gewaschener Grade 1 Lot aus Yirgachef
candidateAudit.text: BANKO GOTITI - definitiv ein Crowd Favourite - ist zurück! Äthiopien Washed Light Roast Wir haben einen neuen Kaffee in unserem Portfolio: Ein gewaschener Grade 1 Lot aus Yirgacheffe, Kochere District – von 650 Kleinbäuer:innen verarbeitet in der Banko Gotiti Washing Station unter der Leitung von Alemu Bukato. Die Kombination aus Höhenlagen bis zu 2.200 Metern, fruchtbaren Böden und reichlichen Niederschlägen, bildet die Basis für die hohe Qualität dieses Mikrolots. Das Geschmacksprofil wird maßgeblich durch die Verwendung traditioneller „Heirloom“-Varietäten geprägt. Diese verleihen dem Kaffee die in dieser Region charakteristischen Zitrusaromen, sowie florale und kräuterige Nuancen von Lavendel, Jasmin und Bergamotte sowie einen teeartigen Körper. Der Kaffee wurde nach dem Depulpen 36–48h fermentiert und anschließend 12–15 Tage auf afrikanischen Hochbetten getrocknet, sorgfältig von Hand selektiert. Das Ergebnis: ein Kaffee, der zeigt, wie präzise gewaschene Aufbereitung schmecken kann. Taste Notes: - Earl Grey - Weißer Pfirsich - Ahornsirup Dieser äthiopische Filterkaffee ist ideal für Pour Over und Aeropress. Ab sofort online und in unserem Shop erhältlich. #süssmundkaffee #coffeeroaster #ethiopiancoffee #viennacoffee #specialtycoffee

Expect an energetic mix of electronic sounds, sharp contrasts, heavy bass, and the genre-bending spirit of hyperpop. Whether you want to listen closely, catch up with friends, work with some decidedly non-background background music, or simply see where the set goes, you are welcome to join us. Date: Friday, 4 September 2026 Time: 16:00–18:00 Location: Villa Vida Café, Linke Wienzeile 102, 1060 Vienna DJ: Leila Szabo Music: Hyperpop, with some dubstep Entry: Free Meet the DJ: Leila Szabo For this edition of Day DJ, Leila Szabo brings hyperpop to Villa Vida Café. Hyperpop is known for pushing pop and electronic music beyond their usual boundaries. It can be bright, distorted, playful, chaotic, melodic, bass-heavy, or all of those things within the same track. What Is Day DJ at Villa Vida? Day DJ at Villa Vida Café is a regular series that gives local DJs space to share their sound in a daytime setting. The series focuses on new talent, experimentation, and community. Rather than putting DJs exclusively into a late-night club environment, Day DJ creates an accessible daytime space where artists can build sets, explore ideas, and connect with an audience. At the same time, the format is deliberately relaxed. You can come specifically for the music, meet friends for a drink, work from the café, or stay for the entire set. candidateAudit.text: 💜 GalPals – Weekly Sapphic Meetup 💜 Every Tuesday, GalPals brings Vienna’s sapphic community together at Villa Vida Café. 🗓 Every Tuesday ⏰ 18:30–22:30 📍 Villa Vida Café 🎟 Free entry GalPals is for sapphics — you do not need to identify as a woman to belong here. Whether you’re lesbian, bi, pan, queer, nonbinary, questioning, somewhere under the sapphic umbrella, or simply know that sapphic community feels like home to you: this meet-up is for you. 🫶 The WLWIEN name is part of where the community started, not a requirement for who gets to belong. If sapphic community feels like your community, there’s space for you at GalPals. 💜 No need to arrive with friends, either. Lots of people come alone, and every Tuesday is a mix of familiar faces and newcomers. GalPals is deliberately low-pressure. You can be shy. You can be introverted. You can take your time warming up. You don’t need to be the loudest person in the room to meet people and become part of the community. 🌈 What to expect ✨ Sapphic community in all its beautiful variety ✨ Regulars + new faces every week ✨ A relaxed way to make friends and meet people ✨ A welcoming space for quieter and socially anxious folks ✨ A multilingual crowd ✨ No entry fee and no pressure to be anything other than yourself English is common, but you absolutely do not need to speak English to join. candidateAudit.text: Throughout August and September, the artist duo MUELLER-DIVJAK is residing at AIL for Summer Studio – using the space for artistic research, experimentation, and learning, developing the project's multisensory scenography – the so-called SΫS SPACE. Aim of the Summer Studio is to prepare the prototype of the scenography, which will be established at the AIL in June 2027 as the centerpiece of the final exhibition of the PEEK project ’SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS — Exploring the Potentials of Multisensory Scenography for Systems Awareness.’ The SΫS SPACE facilitates a physical experience of one's own embededdness within living systems, within complex interrelationships – within a greater whole. It paves the way for relational sensing and thinking – an embodied systems awareness, that can help in coping with complexity, challenges, and uncertainties, and in making good decisions towards sustainable futures. It deliberately reduces the dominance of the sense of sight, placing the emphasis instead on smell, touch, and hearing. Numerous scientists, as well as invited artists, politicians, journalists, children, senior citizens, curators, cultural workers, educators, and teenagers are individually guided through the immersive environment by Jeanette Müller and Paul Divjak and share their responses in photo-based reflections and semi-structured interviews. Their feedback directly informs the prototype. Save the date! 14 and 15 Sep 2026 The SΫS SPACE will open to the public in individual time slots for an exclusive multisensory experience. candidateAudit.title: Die neue Ernte von unserem Kaffee SAN CRISTOBAL aus Chiapas, Mexico ist in unserer Rösterei angekommen. Die Unión Majomut verbindet als gemeinnützige Organisation ca. 1.000 Familie
candidateAudit.text: Die neue Ernte von unserem Kaffee SAN CRISTOBAL aus Chiapas, Mexico ist in unserer Rösterei angekommen. Die Unión Majomut verbindet als gemeinnützige Organisation ca. 1.000 Familien und der Kaffee wird auf kleinen, familiengeführten Farmen biologisch angebaut. Das Ziel der Kooperative ist es, die Lebensbedingungen der Mitglieder durch die Erzeugung, Verarbeitung und Vermarktung von Bio-Kaffee und anderen Bio-Produkten zu verbessern. Wir arbeiten bereits seit einigen Jahren mit der Kooperative zusammen und beziehen den Kaffee direkt. Durch die langfristige, stabile Beziehung erzielen die Produzent:innen ein höheres Einkommen und sind unabhängig von den Schwankungen der Rohstoffmärkte. Wir freuen uns schon darauf die neue Ernte für euch zu rösten! #specialitycoffee #viennacoffee #kaffeeröster #süssmundkaffee #newcoffee

candidateAudit.text: 🎬 Sapphic Film Series: Rebel Dykes Punk meets feminism at the next edition of our Sapphic Film Series at Villa Vida Café. 🖤 Join us for a free screening of Rebel Dykes, a documentary exploring the lives of a group of lesbians who helped shape a radical queer subculture in 1980s London. Through stories of friendship, sex, activism, nightlife, art and resistance, Rebel Dykes takes us into a world where punk collided with feminism and queer people created their own spaces, communities and ways of living. Rather than presenting queer history as something distant or polished, the documentary is told through the people who were there — the rebels who lived, loved, organised, partied and challenged expectations both inside and outside feminist movements. candidateAudit.title: Every drag performance tells a story. Whether it’s joyful, political, deeply personal, or completely absurd, the most memorable performances come from artists who know how to conne
candidateAudit.text: Every drag performance tells a story. Whether it’s joyful, political, deeply personal, or completely absurd, the most memorable performances come from artists who know how to connect with an audience. Join drag artist DaDa JV for an interactive workshop exploring the art of storytelling through drag and performance. Together, you’ll look at how movement, music, character, costume, emotion, and stage presence work together to create performances that leave a lasting impact. This workshop is open to performers of all experience levels, from those taking their first steps into drag to seasoned artists looking to deepen their creative practice. Participants are encouraged to bring ideas, works in progress, or simply their curiosity. Together we’ll explore: • Finding your unique performance voice • Building a story through movement and music • Connecting authentically with an audience • Using drag as a tool for self expression and community • Developing confidence on stage Expect a welcoming, collaborative environment where experimentation is encouraged and every participant’s perspective is valued. Event Details Saturday, August 29 4:00 PM Villa Vida Café, Linke Wienzeile 102, 1060 Vienna This workshop is donation based. Give what you can. No one will be turned away for lack of funds. Come ready to learn, share, and discover new ways to bring your story to life on stage.

candidateAudit.text: Wir präsentieren unsere Klassiker: Coup Joghurt Diese Saison möchten wir euch alle Coups und Eisdessert vorstellen, die einfach nicht mehr weg zu denken sind. Der Coup Joghurt ist ein absolutes Tichy-Original! Die Idee für den Coup stammt noch von unserem Firmengründer Kurt Tichy Senior. Es gibt ihn schon so lange auf unserer Eiskarte, dass der Coup Joghurt sogar 1985, beim Bau unseres Palais de Glace als Glaskunstwerk verewigt wurde! Bis heute erfreut sich diese einfache aber geniale Kreation immer noch großer Beliebtheit! Unsere Coup Joghurt besteht aus Erdbeereis, Kompottfrüchten und natürlich cremigem Joghurt. Graniert wird mit etwas Pistazienstaub und einer Erdbeere. Ein abslut zeitloses Design! Den Coup Joghurt gibt es natürlich auch to Go!

candidateAudit.text: Over the past season, every spin, every step, and every dance has made a real difference. 💜 Thanks to your generosity, Queer Salsa Wien has raised over €850 for the Queer Vienna Mutual Aid Fund (QVMAF) this year already. The Queer Vienna Mutual Aid Fund provides one-off emergency microgrants to queer people in Vienna experiencing unexpected financial hardship. Whether someone is struggling to pay rent, buy groceries, cover medical costs, or get through another crisis, these grants help community members when they need it most. A huge thank you to the incredible Queer Salsa Wien team for organising these classes, and to everyone who has danced, donated, volunteered, and supported this initiative. Every donation, no matter the size, helps build a stronger community based on solidarity and mutual care. Queer Salsa classes will be back at Villa Vida in October but in the meantime you can join their outdoor classes and parties. Follow queersalsawien for information. The Queer Vienna Mutual Aid Fund is an initiative started by hint.wien and villavidacafe. If you’d like to learn more about the Queer Vienna Mutual Aid Fund or make a donation, visit queervienna.at. See you on the dance floor soon. 💃🏽🕺🏿❤️ 💜 Thank you, queersalsawien ! Over €850 raised for the Queer Vienna Mutual Aid Fund in 2026—thank you to everyone who danced and donated. candidateAudit.text: The exhibition [REVERBERATED]. Following the Movement of Memory is still running till this Friday, July 10! Mon–Fri: 11:00–18:00 Last guided tour: Thur, July 9, 17:00 Memory is not a stable record of the past. Rather than functioning as a static archive, it unfolds as a dynamic process in which traces are continuously reshaped by perception, narration, and material conditions. Across these artistic approaches, [REVERBERATED] invites visitors to consider memory not as something simply preserved, but as something continuously produced through interactions between bodies, technologies, and environments. The exhibition thus explores how the past continues to reverberate within the systems of the present. With contributions by: Agustina Belén Agüero, Lobna Awidat, Phin Anibal, Rimon Alyagon Darr, Ronnie Danaher, Tatiana Del Valle, Hasti Ghasedi, Leah Barbara Mukui Giertz, Hanna Hofmann, Tal Horesh, Mauritius Itzinger, Laura Isselhorst, Dina Karaman, Moritz Klarer, Anna Buchner, Leonard Otterbein, David Ristić, Rajarshi Sarkar, Agnes Schyberg, Aryan Shahabian, Majedeh Shahvelayati, Mehrta Shirzadian, Pauline Simon, Laura Chalabi, People of Soil Photos: Lea Dörl

candidateAudit.title: A new series of postcards is now installed at Café Exchange cafe_exchange The series was extracted from the course ‘Drawing: Here & Now’ by Simon Goritschnig zeichnungunddruckgrafi
candidateAudit.text: A new series of postcards is now installed at Café Exchange cafe_exchange The series was extracted from the course ‘Drawing: Here & Now’ by Simon Goritschnig zeichnungunddruckgrafik In collaborative drawing, two people share a single pen – the line becomes a space of negotiation. A play between control and letting go. Who leads – and when? Impulse meets resistance, conviction meets empathy. Not always a conversation, but always an understanding – a dance on paper. These and other experiments are part of the course “Drawing: Here & Now” by Simon Goritschnig, in which students of the department Drawing and Printmaking explore various qualities of drawing beyond observational study. In the project “Reflex,” these experimental setups are set against observational drawing. Students draw in the cashier hall of the former Postsparkasse, intuitively picking up details from architecture and space, as well as situations of coming together: conversations, movements, gazes. In this process, it becomes visible how public and social space is visually probed and explored. The focus lies on reflection — with, through, and within drawing. With contributions by: Andrea Vairelles, Anna Marino, Beth Sorby, Emilia Schönwiese, Flora Schmid, Hannah Horn, Henriette Sonntag, Leo Hasslinger, Maria Lutkova, Max Offergeld, Nikolaus Kohout, Sophie Schweizer, Anija S Dartizio, Timo Pfeifer, Vera Kügel AIL in cooperation with the department Drawing and Printmaking and Simon Goritschnig Image: Henriette Sonntag Design: Atelier Dreibholz Concept Postcard Editions and Production: Eva Weber

candidateAudit.title: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 4 Jul 2026, 15:00 The Geography of Yellow Walls Performance by Mehrta Shirzadian mehrrta Bright yellow becomes
candidateAudit.text: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 4 Jul 2026, 15:00 The Geography of Yellow Walls Performance by Mehrta Shirzadian mehrrta Bright yellow becomes a quiet declaration of care, resistance, and return. Here, the body is reclaimed as homeland, shaped by experience rather than imposed borders. A performance unfolding through turmeric as healing material and the body as living territory. The work is rooted in a deep commitment to women’s health and critical scientific perspectives, engaging forms of embodied knowledge that have long been ignored or erased. The body becomes both evidence and memory, offering its own geography as a space of protection, defiance, and belonging. The performance is adapted to each site, responding to the spatial and contextual conditions of different venues. Mehrta Shirzadian is a performance and multimedia artist and artistic ­researcher working at the intersection of art and science. With a background in molecular biology, mathematics, and computer science, she creates participatory works exploring microbial life, sound, and bodily ecologies, addressing embodiment, agency, and the politics of representation. candidateAudit.text: On view till Saturday (18:00) – An installation presented by the department of Digital Arts / Part of Angewandte Festival René’s Collapse Collection’ is a fictional startup and alternative investment platform that explores the cultural, economic, and emotional afterlife of the collapse of René Benko’s SIGNA empire. Through NFTs, merchandise, video works, and performative sales strategies, the project examines how value is produced through speculation, narrative, and collective belief. Originally developed through public interventions, the project was expanded through a student take over by Digitale Kunst. This exhibition presents new project strands developed by the students: an NFT series reflecting on financial dependency, a merchandise collection appropriating the aesthetics of startup culture and luxury branding, and a series of short-form videos combining influencer culture, promotional performance, and social commentary. Operating at the intersection of installation, performance, and participatory fiction, Renés Collapse Collection invites visitors to engage directly with the mechanisms of speculation, value production, and collapse. A project by by Zora Hünermann and Jakob Margit With contributions by: Ulrike Fritzsche, Koschka Cosmo Keye, Juarez Suarez, Ghanishka Kedar, Sei Jeung, Ghazal Naeimi, Dongjoo Kim, Jazzmin, Margherita Pruneti, Nicolás Henao Bonnet, Roma Bogdanov, and Grisha Terno.

candidateAudit.title: In a world that is seemingly always connected, we lose ourselves in constant contact. As part of Angewandte Festival, AIL presents: Sich zusammen schreiben [to get in touch], A per
candidateAudit.text: In a world that is seemingly always connected, we lose ourselves in constant contact. As part of Angewandte Festival, AIL presents: Sich zusammen schreiben [to get in touch], A performance and poem by Carla Schwering and Timna Lugstein from by the department of Institute of Fine Arts & Media Art – Photography (Sophie Thun) The phrase "Schreiben wir uns zusammen" that on the surface means something like “let’s write to each other again in more detail” actually implies a postponement. In the performance, the artists type excerpts from their shared chat history in a poetic arrangement on two typewriters facing each other – messages in which they attempt to get closer to one another. The time and effort spent cancelling meet ups, for which there is supposedly no capacity is made visible. With the postcards created for the performance, visitors can reconnect with a long-lost friend. On the occasion of Angewandte Festival AIL hosts a selection of performances and installations in the cashier hall and the current exhibition will have more activations. We will give you an overview, step by step AIL, Otto Wagner-Postsparkasse / Georg-Coch-Platz 2, 1010 Vienna

candidateAudit.text: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 3 Jul 2026, 15:30 Darf ich noch einen Satz? (Palimpsest for 8 speakers) Performance by Leonard Otterbein leonard.ottb The audio performance Darf ich noch einen Satz? (Palimpsest for 8 speakers) explores how sound can model processes of memory formation and transformation. Layered oscillations and brief sound textures repeat with phase shifts, gradually overlapping and partially canceling each other out, much like the traces in an overwritten manuscript. The work is inspired by memory research on reconsolidation – in which recalling an event alters its stored form – and its cultural studies counterpart, reconstructivity. The piece is composed of multiple layers of sound that continuously overlap anew, attempting to cancel each other out in the process. In this process, however, the layers are never completely erased, so that fragments of the preceding states always remain Leonard Otterbein is a sound artist and composer with a background in ecology and ecotoxicology, where he studied mixture effects of agricultural pesticides and nanoparticles. His work spans instrumental and electroacoustic composition, examining perceptual thresholds. He works with psychoacoustic effects and approaches sound as spatial and sculptural material shaped by its relation to space. Part of the exhibition [REVERBERATED]. candidateAudit.title: From the project SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS. Exploring the Potentials of Multisensory Scenography for Systems Awareness – a performance by mueller_divjak in front of Otto Wagner Postsp
candidateAudit.text: From the project SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS. Exploring the Potentials of Multisensory Scenography for Systems Awareness – a performance by mueller_divjak in front of Otto Wagner Postsparkasse as part of Angewandte Festival! 'LIMINAL TRACES. Celebrating Acoustic Ecologies' is a dynamic sound lecture that understands the acoustic world as a phenomenon of resonance, shaped by connectedness and interaction. Through the live-curated interplay of field recordings, physical and digital artefacts, the performance traces sonic imprints deeply embedded in our collective memory, presenting them as a new listening experience. Developed within SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS at the AIL, this solar performance explores the intersections of sound, pop history and solar energy, celebrating concept, improvisation and the (unexpected) emergent. The performance ends when the energy collected by the mobile solar unit runs out. — The artist and researcher duo MUELLER-DIVJAK (Dr. Jeanette Müller and Dr. Paul Divjak), who conceived and initiated SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS, is working since 2023 at AIL with international artists and systems scientists to form experiential spaces by artistic means (scenographies) and to create sensory impressions that help us to better understand and resonate with living systems. During the project essential principles of living systems are transformed into olfactory, auditory and tactile artworks / artefacts and used experimentally. Team: Jeanette Müller, Paul Divjak, Alexandra Graupner, Anna-Maria Irgang

candidateAudit.text: Wir präsentieren unsere Klassiker: Coup Melba Diese Saison möchten wir euch alle Coups und Eisdessert vorstellen, die weniger oft im Rampenlicht stehen und trotzdem einfach nicht mehr weg zu denken sind. Der Coup Melba ist ein klassischer Eisbecher der französischen Küche und darf natürlich auch auf unserer Eiskarte nicht fehlen. Erfunden wurde das weltberühmte Dessert in den 1890er Jahren vom Starkoch Auguste Escoffier, zu Ehren der australischen Opernsängerin Nellie Melba. Unsere Interpretation vom Coup Melba besteht aus Vanilleeis mit Himbeersauce, Schlagobers und Kompottpfirsichen. Besonders unsere Himbeersauce macht diesen Coup zu einem Highlight, denn wir erzeugen alle unsere Saucen selbst und kochen hierfür regelmäßig frische Himbeeren ein. Übrigens gibt es den Coup Melba auch to Go!

candidateAudit.title: Bubbly crunchy dough 🎈🍕🔥 During the fermentation of our dough, the yeasts become active and begin to digest the sugars present in the flour. This process is called fermentation.
candidateAudit.text: Bubbly crunchy dough 🎈🍕🔥 During the fermentation of our dough, the yeasts become active and begin to digest the sugars present in the flour. This process is called fermentation. During this process, the yeasts produce carbon dioxide gas, which gets trapped in the dough and is responsible for the formation of bubbles and the leavening of the dough. Mulino Marino is the flour we trust, biodynamic for three generations, easily digestible, and the gold standard in many Roman pizza al taglio shops. After a fermentation period of at least 24 hours, the dough is baked using a refined process that makes it especially crunchy and airy. Try it for yourself! #pixelpizza #pizzavienn #pizzaaltagliovienna #romanpizza

candidateAudit.title: Das größte Lob für uns ist immer, wenn unsere Gäste zufrieden nach Hause gehen, mit einem Lächeln im Gesicht und dem Gefühl, etwas wirklich Gutes gegessen zu haben. ❤️ Und manchmal
candidateAudit.text: Das größte Lob für uns ist immer, wenn unsere Gäste zufrieden nach Hause gehen, mit einem Lächeln im Gesicht und dem Gefühl, etwas wirklich Gutes gegessen zu haben. ❤️ Und manchmal bekommen wir als Dankeschön sogar kleine, wunderschöne Überraschungen von unseren lieben Kunden. Heute hat uns Frau Dr. Itariu – die Internistin von Diego, die immer darauf schaut, dass seine Werte in Ordnung 😉 sind und ihn ab und zu zur Kontrolle schickt 😉 – ein sehr interessantes Buch geschenkt. 📖 Liebe Frau Doktor, ein herzliches Dankeschön dafür. Dieses Buch werden wir am Sonntag gemütlich zu Hause gemeinsam lesen. Und noch ein riesengroßes Dankeschön an unsere liebe Freundin aus der Slowakei, die gemeinsam mit ihrer Familie ganze 140 Kilometer gefahren ist, um unsere Pizza zu genießen. 🇸🇰🍕 Allein diese Wertschätzung bedeutet uns unglaublich viel. Dass Menschen so eine Strecke auf sich nehmen, um unsere Küche zu besuchen, berührt uns wirklich von Herzen. Dazu hat sie uns auch noch 30 frische Bio Eier mitgebracht – eine so liebevolle Aufmerksamkeit. 🥚❤️ Genau solche Momente erinnern uns daran, warum wir lieben, was wir tun. Danke für eure Unterstützung, eure Freundschaft und euer Vertrauen in unsere Küche. Ihr seid ein Teil unserer kleinen La Delizia Familie. ❤️ #kunden #danke #dankeschön #wertschätzend #italianrestaurant

candidateAudit.text: Auch heuer sucht die WKO, zusammen mit dem Kurier, Wiens schönste Schani-Gärten und beste Freizeitoasen. Wir sind wieder in der Kategorie ,,klassischer Schanigarten" mit dabei! Unseren kleinen aber schicken Schanigarten gibt es seid über 50 Jahren! Er wurde in handarbeit extra für uns angefertigt, was ihn zu einem einzigartigen Unikat macht, welches wir bis heute weiter verwenden. Auch die Tische und Sessel sind Originale, aus den 80er Jahren. Die blühenden Pflanztröge, mit deren Pflege wir uns immer viel Mühe geben, runden nicht nur den Retro-Look ab, sondern machen den Reumannplatz auch gleich etwas grüner. In unserem Schanigarten haben ca. 45 Personen gleichzeitig Platz. Wenn euch unser Gastgarten gefällt, würden wir uns sehr über eure Stimme freuen! Bis zum 17. Mai könnt ihr online abstimmen. Unter allen Teilnehmer:innen verlost die WKO Konsumationsgutscheine im Gesamtwert von 2.000 Euro! https://share.google/OfX1IeQO24gJMDxJs

candidateAudit.text: Wir freuen uns riesig darüber, ein Teil der neuen ,,A1.Deins" - Kampagne von a1telekom sein zu dürfen! Hier werden echte Menschen, ihre Lebensrealiät und ganz persönliche Momente gezeigt. Hierbei hat die Kreativ Agentur hinter der Idee, Team E1Ns tatsächlich auch an uns gedacht! Im Mittelpunkt steht aber IHR, unsere treuen Kunden, durch die eine einfache Portion Eis zu etwas ganz Besonderem wird! 🍦❤️ Wir finden das Ergebniss ist großartig geworden und bedanke uns bei allen Beteiligten für die wirklich schöne Zusammenarbeit! 🥰 Übrigens sind auch wir, schon seid vielen Jahren, sehr zurfriedene Businesskunden bei a1telekom! candidateAudit.text: This year we’re celebrating a unique fusion of tradition and botanical mastery. Cantillon has teamed up with Paul, Florian, and Vincent—the three young minds behind Vermouth Sullivan—to create this year’s Zwanze release: Artémis. ✨ Artémis La Blanche (7%): A complex blend of gentian, coriander, rhubarb root, juniper, sage, and wormwood, married with classic Lambic. ✨ Artémis La Rouge (7%): A vibrant mix of verbena, marjoram, rose, apple, curry plant, and wormwood, blended with Kriek. The name Artémis honors the Greek goddess of nature and the plant Artemisia (wormwood)—the soul of every vermouth. 🏹🍃

candidateAudit.text: This Saturday YOU have a date! Am 21. Februar 2026 lädt B-Project zu einem Abend ein, der zeitgenössische queer-feministische Kunst mit Erzählungen und Weinen aus dem Balkan verbindet. Die Veranstaltung findet in der Blechturmgasse 10, 1040 Wien (Wineshop the Opposite of West) statt und beginnt um 19:00 Uhr (bis Mitternacht). Der Abend eröffnet mit der Ankunft der Gäste, gefolgt von einer Rede der Künstlerin* Maja Radosavljević um 19:45 Uhr, mit einem inhaltlichen Fokus auf queere Perspektiven, Körperpolitik und der historischen Genese. Im Anschluss werden Weingeschichten präsentiert, die ausgewählte Weine von Frauen aus dem Balkan vorstellen.

candidateAudit.text: Unser heutiger Einsatzort war wirklich mal was ganz anderes 🥶 Wir waren mit dabei, bei der Einweihung der neuen Osttirol-Lok. Diese fährt jetzt direkt von Wien nach Lienz und durch den neuen Koralmtunnel ist man nochmal viel schneller in unserem schönen Bezirk. Es war äußerst kalt, aber dennoch ein großartiges Event und mit unserem hausgemachten Punsch konnten wir alle eine warme Freude bereiten. Benötigt auch ihr einmal ein etwas anderes Catering mit einzigartigen Osttiroler Schmankerl, dann stehen wir euch gerne zur Verfügung. Wir können von kleinen bis hin zu ganz großen Veranstaltungen alles abdecken, sodass der Tiroler Stubencharakter auch auf eurem Event Einklang findet. Um die Sperrstunde müsst ihr euch aber selbst kümmern, unsere Gäste gehen erfahrungsgemäß sehr ungern. ;) #öbb #osttirol #catering #koralm #osttirolinwien

candidateAudit.text: Die HLTW13 Bergheidengasse und der Absolventen-Verein Club Bergheidengasse veranstalten am 22. Jänner ihr neues Charity-Event ,,Klingt nach..." im WUK Wien und wir sind auch dabei! 🍨 Das Event richtet sich an alle Gastronomie-Fans, die für einen guten Zweck essen und feiern möchten! 🎉 Es wird ein mehrgängiges Menü mit Weinbegleitung und Bühnenshow von Insingizi feat. Pascal Lopongo und Aida Loos, mit anschließendem Clubbing im WUK mit Musik von Drumatical Theatre, DJ Silybeatz, DJ Jessy Gem, DJ Fisso und DJ Nitkov, geben. Gekocht wird von Schülern, zusammen mit Absolventen der Schule, die bereits in renommierten Restaurants arbeiten. Der Reinerlös geht an das Integrationshaus Wien. 🍷🎶🪩 Karten gibt es unter folgendem Link, in den Kategorien Dinner (inklusive Clubbing) und Dance (nur Clubbing): https://www.bergheidengasse.at/klingt-nach/ Wir freuen uns sehr, dieses tolle neue Projekt als Sponsor unterstützen zu dürfen! Wer es also nicht mehr bis zu unserem Saisonstart abwarten kann um wieder Eismarillenködel zu schlemmen, sollte sich ein Ticket sicher und tut ganz nebenbei auch etwas Gutes! ❤️ WUK Pressefoto copyright Wolfgang Thaler

candidateAudit.text: Auch Heuer melden wir uns kurz während unserer Winterpause zurück, denn wir haben eine ganz besondere Auszeichnung bekommen! Den 2. candidateAudit.title: Alles Gute zum Geburtstag, lieber Herr Konditormeister! Heute am 17. August, wäre unser Firmengründer Komm. Rat Kurt Tichy Senior 100 Jahre alt geworden! Dieses Jubiläum möchten wi
candidateAudit.text: Alles Gute zum Geburtstag, lieber Herr Konditormeister! Heute am 17. August, wäre unser Firmengründer Komm. Rat Kurt Tichy Senior 100 Jahre alt geworden! Dieses Jubiläum möchten wir zum Anlass nehmen um uns an ihn zu erinnern und um DANKE zu sagen! Denn sein Fleiß und seine Kreativität, haben den Eissalon Tichy erst möglich gemacht und sind bis heute tief in unserem Unternehmen verankert! ❤️🍨 Kurt Tichy Senior wurde am 17.08.1925 in Wien geboren und träumte schon sehr früh von seiner eigenen Konditorei. Im Jahr 1952 beginnt in einem kleinen Kellerlokal in Simmering die Geschichte des ,,Tichys". Mit nur einer Eismaschine, 5 Eissorten und einem dreirädrigen Eiswagen beliefern Kurt und seine Frau Marianne Tichy die Gärtner der Simmeringer Haide, bei denen sie bald dementsprechend beliebt sind. Nur drei Jahre später, 1955 gründen die beiden den Eissalon Tichy am Reumannplatz in Favoriten, welcher damals freilich noch sehr klein war. Kurt Tichy beginnt eigene Kreationen zu erfinden und im Jahr 1967 schließlich die Eismarillenködel, die später patentiert werden und heute weit über die Grenzen Österreichs bekannt sind! Bis zu seinem plötzlichen Ableben im Jahr 1999, ist Kurt Tichy Senior im Eissalon tätig, welcher sich mittlerweile zu einem richtigen Familienbetrieb entwickelt hat. Auch heute erinnert ein Mosaik im Gang zu unserem Palais de Galce an Herrn Konditormeister Komm. Rat Kurt Tichy Senior, welcher für uns unvergessen bleibt! #happybirthday #eissalontichy #tichysüchtig #eisamreumannplatz #reumannplatz13 #vienna #eismarillenknödel #eis #kurttichy

candidateAudit.text: 📸 Wie stellt ihr euch den ultimativen Wiener Würstelstand vor? 🌭🇦🇹 „Der Stand auf dem Bild ist eine kleine Hommage – ein liebevoller Blick auf die Wiener Würstelstand-Kultur, die sogar als UNESCO-Weltkulturerbe anerkannt ist. Genau das hat uns inspiriert, diese Tradition auf das nächste Level zu bringen und einen Stand zu schaffen, der das Beste aus Alt und Neu vereint. ✨ Unser eigener Stand steht schon bereit, und wir sind in den letzten Vorbereitungen. Bald gibt’s tolle Neuigkeiten – bleibt dran! 🚀🍻 Was wir jetzt schon verraten können: Es gibt erstklassige Würstel, feinstes Gebäck und dazu die perfekten Getränke – von einem kühlen Bier bis zu einem guten Glaserl Wein. Alles von Produzenten, die ihre Sache mit Leidenschaft machen. 🥨🍷 Jetzt seid ihr dran: Was gehört für euch zu einem echten Wiener Würstelstand? Was darf auf der Karte nicht fehlen? Schreibt uns eure Wünsche in die Kommentare – wir freuen uns auf eure Ideen! #WienerWürstelstand #WürstelstandKultur #ViennaEats #ViennaFood #UNESCO #TraditionTrifftModerne #OldSchoolVibes #ComingSoon”

candidateAudit.text: It’s that time of year when Ammut wakes up to check who is loyal to its own living bar. The Ammutsøn family would be honored and happy to celebrate their 6th anniversary with you. And because it’s a special event, it will be full of extraordinary beers, personally selected by Ehren Schmidt and Raf Souvereyns from insight cellers Copenhagencommons and Bokke. They are making a special trip to Vienna to share their beers with us at Ammutsøn for our anniversary. So, come and pay your respects to Ammut with some amazing beers! Cheers 🍻🤘 Raf is my crazy brother from a deferent mother 😂😂 there is a lot to say here but I’ll keep it short just come and have a beer with us we like to celebrate 🤙🍻 Ehren Schmidt is an American brewer and blender who sold his barrel aged brewery in California in 2017 and moved to Denmark to start a wild and spontaneous beer project with Mikkeller, called Baghaven. In 2023, Ehren outright purchased the production facility he built, along with some barrels he created, and started Insight Cellars. Throughout the years Ehren has garnered international attention for his creations, including a bronze at the 2016 World Beer Cup in Philadelphia, PA in the barrel aged wild ale category On Friday the 15th from 16:00 till 18:00 there will be an exclusive Lambic tasting curated by Raf to share with us. And Saturday 16th from 16:00 till 18:00 there will be an exclusive spontaneous fermented wild ales curated by Ehren. Seats are limited so reservations are a must. Wir wollen das Ganze jedoch spannend machen. Für deine Teilnahme bieten wir dir an, dass du mit einem/r Freund/-in 2 unserer neuen Cocktails bei uns kostenlos probieren kannst. Das Gewinnspiel endet am Mittwoch, 31.08.2022 um 23:59 Uhr. Der Gewinner/Die Gewinnerin wird am Sonntag bekanntgegeben. Viel Spaß bei der Umfrage und viel Glück🤞🏻 Das Gewinnspiel wird in keiner Weise von Instagram oder Facebook unterstützt oder organisiert. The Roast Twin Tower ist alleiniger Veranstalter dieses Gewinnspiels. Der Gewinner/Die Gewinnerin wird per Zufallsgenerator gezogen und bei einer Teilnahme (gemäß DSGVO) in der Story veröffentlicht. Keine Barauszahlung. Der Rechtsweg ist ausgeschlossen. candidateAudit.title: Weihnachten steht vor der Tür. Die Zeit der Ruhe und Besinnlichkeit, aber auch manchmal willkommene Gelegenheit des ausufernden Konsums, der Völlerei. Die Fragen, was man seinen Li
candidateAudit.text: Weihnachten steht vor der Tür. Die Zeit der Ruhe und Besinnlichkeit, aber auch manchmal willkommene Gelegenheit des ausufernden Konsums, der Völlerei. Die Fragen, was man seinen Liebsten schenken möchte oder was für Köstlichkeiten dieses Jahr am Weihnachtstisch stehen werden, erscheinen uns vielleicht vordergründig. Leider haben viele Menschen andere Sorgen, wo werde ich die Nacht verbringen, wie werde ich heute meinen Hunger stillen? Wir wollen im Rahmen unserer Möglichkeiten erinnern, dass nicht alle Menschen privilegiert sind und einen Solidaritätsbeitrag von unseren Gästen einfordern. Jeder Gast wird dazu "genötigt" 5 Euro an die Wiener Tafel zu spenden. Mit diesem Betrag ermöglichen Sie der Wiener Tafel 50 bedürftigen, hungrigen Menschen zu helfen. Im letzten Jahr konnten wir mit der Unterstützung unserer großzügigen Gäste 14.000 Menschen ein warmes Essen bescheren. Wir sind guter Dinge, dass die Bescherung dieses Jahr noch schöner ausfällt.
